name: aurora-high-cpu
title: An Aurora instance has sustained high CPU utilisation
description: An Aurora instance has had average CPU utilisation at or above 85% for 45 minutes.
investigation_steps: Open the alarm to identify the affected Aurora instance.
Check database connections, query activity and Performance Insights.
Investigate expensive queries, unusual application traffic or insufficient database capacity.
This could lead to service degradation or unavailability if the high CPU usage persists.
Using breakglass to temporarily increase database capacity may be necessary to restore service performance while addressing the underlying issue.
